scope: Root static audit of three papers/frameworks and one downstream benchmark

papers.name: SceneEval
papers.official_proof: https://3dlg-hcvc.github.io/SceneEval/ (Code link leads to official repo)
papers.eval_code_status: Actual metric modules and non-VLM evaluation plan verified.
paper_evaluation: Explicit requirements: object counts/attributes/object-object and object-architecture relations; implicit plausibility: collision/support/navigability/accessibility/out-of-bounds/opening clearance.
COL uses mesh collision manager with small 5mm displacement recheck; counts objects participating in collisions, not colliding-pair fraction.
NAV rasterizes rotated boxes; default robot width 0.2m, resolution256; largest walkable component / all walkable space. It does not by itself ensure reachability from door.
SUP uses inferred support type and geometric contact/centroid hull; ACC uses inferred functional sides. These are proxies, not gravity simulation.
papers.actual_input_profile: Evaluator consumes generated SceneState + real assets + annotated user requirements; it is not a generation baseline.
commands: python main.py (README demo; evaluates its bundled methods/examples, not FastFill without adapter)
limits: Requires Blender/asset preparation and scene conversion.
COL/NAV/OOB/opening clearance need no VLM; count/attributes/relations/support/accessibility use the default VLM pathway.
Full experimental reproduction, asset downloads and VLM judgments were not executed.
Stable request-ID inventory checks should be deterministic in FastFill; do not replace them with VLM category matching.
papers.fit_for_fastfill: First choice for shared geometry and usability evaluation after RoomGenBench assembly; preserve definitions and report component metrics.

papers.name: LEGO-Eval
papers.official_proof: Paper abstract links https://gyeomh.github.io/LEGO-Eval/; project Code link resolves to https://github.com/gyeomh/LEGO-EVAL.
papers.eval_code_status: Actual evaluation pipeline, tools and aggregation verified; not all paper experiments located/executed.
paper_evaluation: Paper: holistic success means every constraint for a description holds; partial success means fraction of valid constraints, grouped by Floor Layout/Material Selection/Object Selection/Object Placement.
Separate evaluator validation measures F1 and Cohen kappa against human judgments. These assess the judge, not the layout generator.
Source main.py computes total partial as sum(num_correct)/sum(num_constraints); paper main table Avg is average by constraint type. Keep these aggregation conventions separate.
papers.actual_input_profile: Text instructions + generated AI2THOR/Holodeck-compatible scene with real asset information; evaluator invokes scene/geometry/image/text tools.
commands: bash scripts/run.sh (fill paths/model/endpoints; it calls python evaluation/main.py)
limits: AI2THOR pinned build, Xorg/GPU, Objathor assets/materials/multiview asset images and model endpoints are needed.
Tool selection/constraint validation still uses LLM/VLM; not a deterministic geometry-only validator.
Current main entry returns success ratios; F1/kappa human calibration is not the same output.
Strict full-scene success depends on a frozen nonempty request-constraint set; record judge/version/seed/failures.
papers.fit_for_fastfill: Adopt atomic requirement checks plus all-constraints scene success. Use VLM only for appearance/ambiguous semantics and calibrate on a small human-labeled subset.

papers.name: SemLayoutDiff
papers.eval_code_status: Unified evaluator and all four metric modules verified.
paper_evaluation: FID/KID from common resized renderings via clean-fid; SCA learns real-vs-synthetic classifier; CKL compares category distributions; OOB checks generated scene states.
Important source definition: calculate_oob.py only checks bbox.position XY inside first floor polygon (strict Point.within); does not test object footprint/OBB/mesh extent.
Source SCA creates model and optimizer once outside its ten-run loop: run scores are successive training stages, not ten independently reset models.
papers.actual_input_profile: Room/architecture mask + room type → semantic map → predicted object sizes/poses. Standard release does not enforce our exact supplied furniture inventory.
limits: Need original splits, renderings and scene-state conversion; SSTK/asset metadata used for rendering.
README contains real HuggingFace weight/data links alongside placeholder wget examples. We did not download or validate those artifacts.
Scene plausibility is delegated to separate SceneEval repo.
Do not report its center-only OOB as full-footprint/mesh OOB; do not treat its ten SCA stages as independent-run uncertainty.
No-floor scenes return None: directory JSON count stays in scene-OOB denominator but object totals exclude them. FastFill must record missing-shell cases as unknown/failure, not passed.
papers.fit_for_fastfill: Useful architecture-conditioned comparison and distribution-metric reference; requires inventory conditioning adaptation, so not a drop-in same-input baseline.

papers.name: RoomGenBench
papers.official_proof: Project README and existing FastFill submodule mapping redirect from RunyiYang/RoomGenBench to WorldEdge-Lab/RoomGenBench; not classified as a peer-reviewed paper.
papers.eval_code_status: Render, geometry, VLM and aggregation entry points verified.
paper_evaluation: Fixed-layout asset generation/assembly benchmark: 5 rooms, 313 object instances, 184 unique type-description assets.
Per-asset four-view VQA description/category, SigLIP-2 similarity, retrieval R@5; support ray consistency and coverage. Room VQA auxiliary.
Reference DINO/SAGE and mesh F-score are reference diagnostics, not proof of a unique correct asset.
Aggregate support criterion is hit_rate>=0.5 and absolute median gap<=0.02m, for available object-support pairs. Missing mesh pairs reduce denominator; coverage includes fallback status.
papers.actual_input_profile: Given room/object boxes/descriptions and original support relationships → generate/retrieve and fit real meshes; evaluates downstream asset quality, not unknown layout generation.
commands: python bench/score_aggregate.py (after renders, geometry and VLM raw outputs; upstream README offers Slurm launchers)
limits: Current scorers enumerate the original five scenes and expect benchmark paths/results. Dynamic FastFill scenes need scorer adapters.
Requires render/model weights/assets; no GPU/VLM evaluation executed.
Anisotropic bbox fitting can hide native asset-size problems; preserve native and fitted mesh sizes and distortion.
Separate missing/fallback/actual mesh coverage, and retain required support pairs in the end-to-end failure denominator.
papers.fit_for_fastfill: Required downstream layer; add shared collision/OOB/door reachability after real meshes are fitted. Do not reuse original GT layouts/support as main-task inputs.

cross_review.scope: Existing local sources only; no network/edits
verified: LEGO micro partial denominator and holistic denominator
SemLayoutDiff center-only OOB, first floor, strict within
SemLayoutDiff SCA model/optimizer reused across ten loop stages
cross_review.limits: Paper table type-macro convention is sourced to paper section 5.2; not inferred solely from implementation.
